column1: # Target: RDK OS V5.1.0, arm64/aarch64, ROS 2 Jazzy.  This is deliberately
# limited to the RDK DEB-build toolchain.  RDK OS supplies the Jazzy
# CycloneDDS runtime itself; keeping it out of this carrier avoids replacing
# RDK-owned ROS and base-system packages.  Sensor
# runtime packages (RealSense, DepthAI, GStreamer, supervisor, etc.) remain
# owned by their Sensor-specific dependency bundle.
